BOOK ONE · LESSON 116

Every, no, any and some 每一、无、若干和一些

每一、无、若干和一些

A picture lesson introducing the compound pronouns of 'every', 'no', 'any' and 'some'. Twelve pictures (a-l) illustrate everyone/everybody, everything, everywhere, anyone/anybody, anything, anywhere, no one/nobody, nothing, nowhere, someone/somebody and somewhere. The written exercises rewrite sentences and answer questions using these compounds, and the grammar workbook drills filling blanks and completing dialogues.

116 / 144 LESSONS3 PARTSREAD · WRITE · PRACTISE
01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

Word box: Every / Everyone / Everybody / Everything / Everywhere | None / No one / Nobody / Nothing / Nowhere | Any / Anyone / Anybody / Anything / Anywhere | Some / Someone / Somebody / Something / Somewhere

单词表：每一（everyone/everybody/everything/everywhere）| 无（no one/nobody/nothing/nowhere）| 若干（anyone/anybody/anything/anywhere）| 一些（someone/somebody/something/somewhere）

Twelve pictures (a-l): a Everyone is asleep. Everybody is asleep. b Everything is untidy. c I looked for my pen everywhere. d Is there anyone at home? Is there anybody at home? e Is there anything in that box? f I couldn't find my pen anywhere. g There's no one at home. There's nobody at home. h There's nothing in this box. i Where did you go yesterday? Nowhere. I stayed at home. j There's someone in the garden. There's somebody in the garden. k There's something under that chair! l My glasses must be somewhere! You're wearing them!

十二张图片（a-l）：a 大家都睡着了。b 什么东西都乱七八糟。c 我在到处找我的钢笔。d 家里有人吗？e 那个盒子里有什么吗？f 我到处找不到我的钢笔。g 家里没有一个人。h 这个盒子里什么都没有。i 你昨天去哪儿了？哪儿也没去。我待在家里。j 园子里有人。k 那把椅子下面有什么东西！l 我的眼镜一定在什么地方！你正戴着呢！

Listen and answer the questions
